title: IncomingMailReply
description: LLM output for reply authoring (spec section 12). The LLM writes the reply text only; it never changes the approved action.

body.description: Plain-text reply body in the customer's language.

needs_human_review.description: True when the LLM could not safely produce a final reply and a human should review.

review_reason.description: Short reason when needs_human_review is true; null otherwise.
